import.title: A little order.
import.subtitle: A safer vault.
import.description: Your vault, without the clutter. Inspect, edit, and reorganize your Bitwarden or Vaultwarden export — entirely on your device.
import.open: Open an unencrypted JSON export from Bitwarden or Vaultwarden.
import.plaintext: Your vault contains plaintext passwords. This application processes the file locally and does not upload it anywhere.
import.steps: A CLEAN VAULT IN THREE STEPS
import.noSetup: No account. No setup. No surprises.
import.step1Text: Load your JSON. Make an original backup before you start.
import.step2Text: Edit credentials, tidy folders, and inspect potential duplicates.
import.step3Text: Validate and download a compatible JSON file, ready to re-import.
import.footer: No cloud. No tracking. No stored passwords.
import.peace: Made for a little peace of mind.
import.readyText: {name} is open locally. Before making changes, download a copy of your original export for safekeeping.
import.secrets: Both files contain plaintext secrets. Keep them in a safe place.

folder.groupTitle: {path} — grouping path, not a folder object
folder.first: Create your first folder, then assign items to it.
folder.nesting: Subfolders use slash-separated names, such as Work/Development. Grouping paths do not add objects to your export unless you explicitly create them.

folder.mergeText: Move items into the destination, then remove the selected folders. Items are not merged.
folder.deleteText: Remove folders only. All credentials are kept and reassigned to the destination below.
folder.removeBranch: The entire branch will be removed, and all its items moved to one destination.
folder.keepBranch: Subfolders stay at their current paths. The deleted parent may still appear as a virtual grouping path.

review.description: Inspect candidates. Nothing is merged or deleted automatically.

export.description: Validation checks the working document before download. Unknown fields and unsupported item types are preserved.
export.more: {count} more results. See Review vault for the full list.
export.ready: No issues found. Ready to go.
export.repair: Repair errors before exporting a compatible document. Your original copy remains available.
export.warning: Warnings are advisory and do not block export. The downloaded file contains plaintext secrets.

audit.title: Session changes
audit.description: An audit of applied actions — never secret values. Undo removes an action from this list.
audit.unchanged: Your original vault has not been changed.
audit.hint: Undo keeps up to 30 in-memory snapshots. Closing the vault clears the document and all history.

help.title: A local workspace, not a password manager
help.description: Vaultsort edits unencrypted Bitwarden / Vaultwarden JSON in memory. There is no backend, account, telemetry, or vault storage. Only language and theme preferences are saved locally. Never open a vault on an untrusted device.
help.saving: Apply item edits, then export to save your work. Closing or refreshing loses the in-memory vault. Your browser controls downloads and the clipboard; protect exported files and clear clipboard history yourself.
help.privacy: After import, your original file can be downloaded byte-for-byte. No vault data is retained when you close it; JavaScript cannot guarantee secure erasure of browser-managed memory.
